normalization: Split actual lines before whitespace normalization; identify proxies before NFKC; normalize retained fragments with NFKC; collapse whitespace to ASCII space; trim fragment ends
numeric_punctuation: Retain Chinese commas between decimal numbers, including signs, decimal fractions and exponents, allowing surrounding whitespace
boundary_context: Require at least one Han neighbor at normalized, whitespace-trimmed fragment edges; do not skip quotes or symbols; Han means CJK unified/compatibility ideograph blocks plus U+3007

sample_filter.action: Discard pairs touching a flagged fragment; never reconnect across rejected fragments
sample_filter.whole_fragment_pattern: ^[\s.。…·⋯]*(?:更多|查看详情|点击展开|展开全文|返回顶部|阅读全文)[\s.。…·⋯]*$
